strings.string: Where to send the arrival event.
https://your-home-assistant, no trailing slash. Must be HTTPS with a certificate that validates.
A long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile, under Security.
The Home Assistant event to fire, e.g. garmin_edge. Your automation triggers on it.
Pressing STOP within the radius of Home Assistant's home zone fires the event. START, auto-pause and LAP never do.
Sent as the event's action, e.g. Arrive. Your automation matches on it.
How close to home counts. 0 uses the radius of your Home Assistant home zone.
